$schema: Component library catalog for the UX Chats imagery system. Each entry is a reusable, hand-authored SVG (never AI-generated) that posters composite in by name instead of re-generating from a prompt every time.

components.name: pen-nib
components.description: Vector pen-tool nib with anchor points and bezier handles — a design-tool motif.

colorVars.--icon-color: line art and fill color — defaults to ink (#1C1430)

components.name: browser-wireframe
components.description: Browser chrome with wireframe content (image placeholder, text lines, a CTA bar) and a cursor arrow.

colorVars.--icon-color: line art color — defaults to ink (#1C1430)
colorVars.--accent-color: CTA bar fill — defaults to accent-orange (#FF5A1F)

components.name: ai-chip
components.description: Rounded chip with circuit-leg pins and a baked-in 'AI' label.

colorVars.--icon-color: line art, pins, and label color — defaults to ink (#1C1430)

components.name: calendar
components.description: Simple grid calendar with binding rings.

colorVars.--icon-color: line art and grid dot color — defaults to ink (#1C1430)
colorVars.--accent-color: one highlighted grid dot — defaults to accent-orange (#FF5A1F)

components.deprecated: Its original purpose was labeling a date/time card. Rule as of 2026-08-10: never add date/time badges to poster images (date/time go in social copy, not the image). Do not use this icon to display a date or time on a poster. Kept only in case a non-date scheduling context comes up (e.g. a generic 'save the date' motif with no literal date text) — confirm before using.

components.name: star-burst
components.description: Two-point sparkle/star cluster (one large, one small). Scoped to the Special Guest Night sub-identity only — the star ban in DESIGN.md still applies everywhere else.
components.recommendedSize: 40-100px, scattered 2-3x per poster in empty corners

colorVars.--icon-color: fill color — defaults to white, use accent-orange on light backgrounds

components.restriction: Special Guest Night posters (with a real speaker headshot) only. Do not use on Community Night, Game Night, Workshop, or Partnership posters — the parent DESIGN.md 'no stars' rule still governs those.

components.name: curved-arrow
components.description: Hand-drawn curved annotation arrow, pointing from a label toward the element it references.
components.recommendedSize: 120-260px depending on the distance it needs to span

colorVars.--icon-color: stroke color — defaults to ink (#1C1430), use white on dark canvases
